messages:
sophie: Following up on the KV-eviction & rate-limit postmortem — we need to convert remediation items into runnable tests. Proposing a focused 2-week sprint starting Mon. Goals: regression promptset, load replay job, and a staging chaos drill. Who can own which?

alex: I can own the regression promptset. I'll pull sample prompts from the incident traces and add a small harness to run them in evals. Target Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll take load scenario. Need infra help to provision a short-lived runner with realistic session timings. Will draft a traffic profile by Tue AM. cc @dylan

jordan: I'll do the chaos drill + runbook. Plan: run on staging with a 10% canary then ramp. First dry-run next Fri.

dylan: infra can provision a 2-node ephemeral cluster for the replay and CI job. Maria, send exact VU/hour and retention for metrics. Example runner CLI to mirror: 
```
k6 run --vus 3000 --duration 30m script.js --out influxdb
```

sophie: Action list & dates I added to the board:
- alex: regression promptset + pass/fail criteria (P95 latency, token blowup guardrails) — Wed EOD
- maria: load profile + infra requirements — Tue noon
- jordan: chaos drill doc + safe checklist — Thu EOD
- dylan: infra carve + CI job + access — Wed EOD
I'll create cards and set reminders. Add PRs/links to the cards when ready.

alex: For pass/fail: require latency P95 < 200ms on replay window and error rate < 0.5%. I'll include both the bad-case prompts and a cleaned baseline.

maria: Question: do we prefer recorded replay from the incident traces or synthetic traffic? Replay is higher fidelity but needs sanitization.

sophie: Prefer replay. If sanitization blocks us, fallback to synthetic with matching token-size and session timing distributions.

deploy-bot: Card created: "PMT: KV eviction -> tests" assigned to sophie — https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/456 (automated)

jordan: Suggest a regression gate: if KV eviction incidence > 0.1% over 24h OR model-fallback rate > 0.5%, auto-fail rollout and page oncall. We should codify thresholds and the auto-fail behavior in the gating doc.

alex: I'll add gating thresholds to the evals gating doc and open a PR against the pipeline config.

sophie: Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 11:00 for quick sync (15m). Two-week retro after sprint. If tasks slip, update the board and ping me. :heart:

maria: I'll post the draft load profile tomorrow with replay snippets if possible.

jordan: I'll publish the runbook checklist (traffic cutover, monitoring knobs, rollback steps) before the drill.

sophie: Great — owners assigned, timelines set, cards live. I'll follow up with invites and reminders. Ping me if you need incident traces or access to sanitized logs.
